`canonical-policy-creator.json` is an independent ABI oracle generated by the
Loyal Apps Solita SDK at commit `45de590113312d54de7585a710620a8a80b504db`.
The canonical matrix follows `packages/smart-account-vaults/src/client.ts`
1894–2004 and the creator action follows 11747–11822. Delegation instruction
bytes come from `packages/loyal-actions/src/subscriptions.ts`.

The fixture includes the exact instruction bytes/metas, serialized current
policy and Settings accounts, a weakened owner constraint, a signed legacy
creator, a signed v0 creator with separate payer and root signatures and pinned
lookup addresses, and a signed recurring delegation creator. Account counters
and start reflect state after creation so current-state verification cannot
mistake mutable counters for immutable policy constraints.

To regenerate, use Bun with the pinned Apps checkout and its installed SDK
packages. The generator checks its ABI source files against that commit first:

```sh
bun canonical-policy-creator.fixture.ts /path/to/loyal-apps > canonical-policy-creator.json
```

Fixtures are deterministic test accounts and signatures; no provider requests,
secrets, or financial transactions are used to generate them.
